purpose: Track native UI destinations and evidence while preserving existing VR interactions.

required: resource identity or verified native producer
identification_contract.unknown: Record and classify. A verified open menu with no device surface uses the spatial fallback; do not promote arbitrary world or optical draws into a panel.

surfaces.preserve: Weapon/status and ordinary notifications stay on the left forearm.
Native maps, missions, management, ordinary/forced stow and immediate reopening.

surfaces.observed: Candidate 5f73f4917b24 shows guidance at the native left-hand iDroid emitter with holding hand and live full body in separate left/right launch, ground impact and return recordings. Four post-flight open/stow/reopen cases pass. Target destruction, pre-stowed state, tracking loss, interruptions and other arm variants remain unproven. The latest checked build adds remote-lens failure isolation without a fresh live run. Release is held for the user's headset test.
requirements: Identify exact flight producer and start/end state
Maintain fresh Snake world, body and hand rendering across native projectile-camera ownership changes; retained stereo is not live-body proof
Render live feed at the authored iDroid projector with correct aspect
Restore prior device state after return, interruption, death and loading

surfaces.preserve: Known active popup detection and missing-device fallback; no stranded flat-only dialog.
Handheld binocular aiming, zoom, acquisition, explicit marking and real firearm sights; no detached zoom window.

requirements: Preserve ordinary title menu access without cassette handling
Exercise developed equipment and mission-specific flows
Do not assume every feed shares the Rocket Arm owner
Explicit app focus and media controls
Keep playback input separate from native gameplay
Validate media content, audio, performance and headset readability

audit_sequence: Catalogue owned UI assets and native producer identities, including mission-loaded resources.
Catalogue camera ownership transitions and every XR fallback trigger as well as UI draws: projectile flight, cinematics, vehicles, death, loading and deployment.
Collect bounded live draw inventories before, during and after each action; retain unknown owners and truncation limits.
Join each draw to its intended device, content producer and lifecycle; replace blanket routing only with evidence-backed classification.
Capture both eyes through open, interact, head/hand movement, close, reopen and interruption cases.
Check for duplicated content, missing desktop-only dialogs, wrong aspect, unreadable pixels and unexpected input capture.
Keep unvisited scenes and undeveloped equipment explicitly untested; simulator checks do not imply physical-headset acceptance.

scenario_groups: loadout and every available equipment family
confirmation, error, save and connection dialogs
Rocket/Blast Arm and other remote cameras
coverage_contract.discovery_limit: Current draw inventory is capped at 96 nodes and groups by camera/order/join state; it is a discovery aid, not an exhaustive resource inventory.
coverage_contract.completion_rule: No all-UI acceptance until enumerated producers and transitions have matched live cases; retain unknown and unvisited entries explicitly.
